GENERAL PASSENGER INFORMATION
AIRCRAFT - SFO operates Sikorsky S-61N Twin-Jet, 26 passen-
ger amphibious turbocopters; and S-62A 10 passenger Jet powered
turbocopters.
AIRLINE CODE - OH is the official code for SFO Helicopter
Airlines.
BAGGAGE - Free Allowance - DOMESTIC (USA & Canada) - 40
pounds; INTERNATIONAL - 66 pounds. Baggage in excess of the
above free allowance will be charged at the published tariff rates.
CHECK-IN - Passengers must check in at the boarding gate or
station at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled departure time,
or the passenger's reservation can be cancelled and made avail-
able to anyone else standing by.
CONDITION OF CARRIAGE - Tariff rules provide that no person
may be boarded whose conduct, status, age, or mental or physical
condition is such as to render such person incapable of caring
for himself without assistance from others. Current tariffs for pub-
lic inspection are available at all offices of SFO Helicopter Air-
lines, All schedules and information published in this timetable
are subject to change without prior notice. SFO Helicopter Airlines
may also alter or cancel any of the schedules published herein
without first giving notice.
CONNECTING TIMES - S.F. Airport: Domestic - Helicopter to
AAL, TWA and WAL 15 minutes. To others 20 minutes. From AAL,
TWA and WAL to helicopter 20 minutes. From others 30 minutes.
International - 1 hour.
CONNECTING TIMES - Oakland Airport: Domestic - All carriers
to and from helicopter 20 minutes. International - 1 hour.
HELICOPTER CARRIERS - We suggest our passengers use the
scheduled helicopter services of ANSETT - A. N. A., BRITISH
LOS ANGELES AIRWAYS, INC.,
NEW YORK AIRWAYS, INC.,
LINES, and SABENA BELGIAN WORLD AIRLINES
CHEDULES - Schedules show the time at which flights may b
xpected to arrive or depart, - but SFO Helicopter Airlines wil
not be responsible for consequences arising from delays or from
errors in the printed schedule. Times shown are subject to change
without notice. SFO Schedules are included in the San Francisco
listing of the North American Quick Reference Edition (QRE) of the
Official Airline Guide (OAG), in table 325 of the OAG and in table
1756 of the ABC World Airways Guide.
TICKETING - All major airlines offer FREE or REDUCED SFO
HELICOPTER FARES to speed their passengers to and from the
airport. (See reverse side for eligibility and rates). To be certain of
gaining these savings ASK ANY TRAVEL AGENT OR AIRLINE
TICKET AGENT TO INCLUDE A FLIGHT COUPON FOR EACH
HELICOPTER LEG OF THE TRIP WHEN PURCHASING AIR
TRANSPORTATION TO AND FROM THE S.F. BAY AREA. All
SO agents can ticket these reduced fares for eligible passengers,
but only
other duties and time permit.
RESERVATIONS - Reservations may be made at any airline ticket
or reservations office. travel agency or by callina SFO Helicopter
Airlines direct. (Use local numbers shown on schedule).
REDIT CARDS - Convenient American Express, Bank Americar
Diner's,
First National Bank of San Jose
Universal Air Travel
Plan (UATP) or SFO Helicopter Airlines Credit Card are honored
at all SO ticket counters.
